title: SWE working on an Unreal Engine game looking to join a few communities
author: aceplayer55
selftext:
Hey all just wanted to join a few communities to chat about things I've learned and stuff I wish I knew in my journey to create some Unreal Engine games.

A little about my gaming background - I started creating games as a hobby, been playing pretty much everything since I was a kid but wanted to move into making my own stuff for fun. 

My first attempt at a game was a MOBA of all things, it worked great as a humbling experience and I essentially learned the basics of UE. Of course it didn't work out since I was too dumb to know what I didn't even know. This was 3 years ago.

A bit later I toned it down and started working on a 2 player horror-puzzle game. Think Amnesia but for two people. That one is around 80% done and I'm leaving AI out of it since its been an incredible learning experience. Hoping to go back to that soon.

What I'm working on now: A 99% AI backend coded c++ brawler style game that uses the Fab and Humble bundle assets I've acquired over the last few years. That means everything the player sees will be human made, but everything I can do (the SWE part) will be done by Claude.

I started by building a set of fable-researched MD files and skills that were tailored to unreal engine 5.8. Using these I started building the game bit by bit, telling Claude to set up a friction file containing any problems it ran into along the way.

So far so good. The game is still a long way from done but I wanted to start getting involved with AI game-dev friendly communities. 

My plan, once the game is done is to put the skills, md files, and python scripts open source on git, and have the game for free on Steam. That's still some way off. If you have any questions about the progress of the game so far, feel free to ask. 

BTW - The screenshot is very orange, I'm aware that things just kind of blend together. I'm working on a few other things today but will tune the lighting soon.
